title: dispatch project registry
description: One entry per lab: which dandisets it maps incoming -> standardized, and how to run its conversion script. See ../README.md for the full field reference.

lab.description: Must match both the labs/<lab>/ directory and its sessions.json key.

incoming_dandiset_id.description: Dandiset id on the ember archive holding the raw upload.

standardized_dandiset_id.description: Dandiset id the converted/standardized output is uploaded to. May equal incoming_dandiset_id.

script_path.description: Path (repo-root-relative) to the conversion script, hashed to detect when it changes.

convert_command.description: Argv list to run the conversion. Tokens may use {repo_root}, {incoming_dir}, {standardized_dir}.

overwrite_flag.description: Optional single flag appended to convert_command when script_path's hash has changed.
